title: What If an NBA Team Paid Players in $1 Bills?
description:
One NBA team's salary cap: about 154.6 million dollars. Now pay it in ones.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: NBA salary cap: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NBA_salary_cap
- Wikipedia: United States one-dollar bill: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_one-dollar_bill

2025-26 NBA salary cap: $154.647 million (NBA.com, cited on Wikipedia). A $1 bill weighs about 1 gram and is 0.0043 inches thick. Our math: 154.647 million grams = about 155 tonnes; counting one bill a second = about 4.9 years; 30 teams x $154.647 million = about 4.64 billion bills, a stack about 507 km high. Not financial advice.

#shorts #nba #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you see a buzzer beater, remember:
cta: The cash or the trophy? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: One NBA team's salary cap: about 154.6 million dollars. Now pay it in ones.
Just 1 dollar bills. One gram each.
Then weigh it. About 155 tonnes of cash.
Just counting it, one bill a second? Almost five years.
Then stack all 30 teams. About 500 kilometers high.
